ana: Heads-up: pilot customer asked for a lightweight observability launch next week. Must-haves: per-route 7d cost rollup, one-click jump from error to trace, and a tiny dashboard template. Can we ship behind flag quickly?
ben: Quick feasibility: cost aggregation backend exists but UI wiring is new. Trace jump needs consistent trace_id header (`X-RW-CTX`) and a normalized URL scheme.
frank: Risks: capture can pick up PII in traces. Suggest default capture OFF, enable only for pilot orgs. Also set sampling to 0.005% by default.
chee: UX: keep dashboard to one row of widgets: cost sparkline, error rate, recent traces. Add a subtle "Hosted only" badge; don't promise Dedicated/Private yet.
ana: sorry typo, meant ana.
ben: Implementation plan: small middleware to copy `X-RW-CTX` into error records when flag ON. UI PR for dashboard tile + error detail link. ETA: backend PR Wed, UI Thu.
frank: Add retention knob per-org (pilot default 14d). Legal: pinged about PII handling. We need an approval before broad rollout.
ana: again ana: canary plan: feature flag `obs-lite-v1` -> roll to pilot org in us-east-1, observe trace ingress and cost delta for 48h, then expand.
deploy-bot: Flag `obs-lite-v1` created and scoped to pilot org in us-east-1.
chee: Acceptance checklist: flag exists, dashboard renders with pilot data, error->trace opens trace view, sampling + retention are configurable, legal ack recorded.
nana: I'll post a short runbook and tag solutions + legal. If pilot signs contract today we make this sprint top priority.
